forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RETIRE-OBE 2026-10-03. Knesset dissolved July 17, 2026 at the natural end of its four-year term — the first full-term completion since 1988 (Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, 2026-07-17). YES path A (coalition loses majority in Knesset roll-call) is structurally impossible: no sitting Knesset exists. YES path B (Netanyahu announces early dissolution) is moot: dissolution already occurred at term end, not early. Neither YES condition was triggered. Resolution criteria structurally impossible from this date; question has zero remaining information value.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO at horizon. US CENTCOM struck IRGC targets inside Iran September 1; Iran retaliated with ballistic missiles same day; Kuwait air defenses engaged Iranian missiles September 2. Active bilateral kinetic exchange precluded any Iranian diplomatic opening. UNGA indirect talks did not begin until September 23 — 17 days after the F2 horizon. No named Iranian official issued a public commitment to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations before EOD September 6. Fortune Sep 1 headline ('ready to return to ceasefire') fails both source-rule (not TIER1) and ambiguity-rule (conditional offer). RESOLVE-NO: HIGH confidence.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
indicators.expected_effect: +60pp toward YES — not observed before horizon

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO at horizon. Araghchi's own mid-August statement that message-relay 'does not amount to a return to talks' directly triggers the ambiguity rule. The first TIER1-confirmed formally convened session (UNGA indirect talks, Qatar-mediated, Araghchi-Witkoff) occurred September 23–24 — six days after the September 17 horizon. No evidence of a formally convened indirect negotiating session between named officials before September 17. RESOLVE-NO: HIGH confidence.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO at horizon today. Week of September 23–30: 119 total transits (~17/day 7-day average), far below the 30/day threshold. Over one-third ran dark (AIS disabled). IMF PortWatch recorded 1 transit on September 27. The single highest daily count was 25 transits on September 27, of which 14 were dark. UKMTO reported three commercial vessels struck September 30. IRGC mine-laying activity resumed after US strikes September 1. No 7-day window in the September 3 – October 3 period reached 30/day. RESOLVE-NO: VERY HIGH confidence.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.

forecasts.question: Will Iranian forces conduct at least one confirmed attack on a commercial vessel in or near the Strait of Hormuz or Arabian Gulf before EOD 2026-10-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. UKMTO reported three commercial vessels struck September 30, including a crude oil tanker and an LNG carrier, consistent with IRGC maritime-denial operations documented throughout August–September 2026. The IRGC separately claimed capture of a US unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait. Documented IRGC operational cadence: 1–3 vessel incidents per week since August 17. On current tempo, at least one kinetic incident in any 72h window is the modal expectation. P=0.72 reflects this cadence; 0.28 residual accounts for a quiet period or an unattributed attack triggering the ambiguity rule.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if UKMTO, CENTCOM, or two independent TIER1 sources confirm at least one kinetic attack (projectile, mine detonation, drone strike, or boarding) against a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Arabian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman before EOD 2026-10-06. Harassment only (radio threats, vessel shadowing) without kinetic contact = NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: UKMTO incident alert OR CENTCOM press release OR two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unattributed attack where Iranian involvement is unconfirmed: resolve based on incident confirmation alone (any confirmed maritime attack counts, regardless of claimed perpetrator, given current operational environment). If only state-media claims without UKMTO/CENTCOM/TIER1 corroboration: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the US conduct a major airstrike package against Iranian territory (≥10 aircraft sorties or ≥5 cruise missiles) before EOD 2026-11-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 31-day forecast. Trump September 27 Axios interview ('renewed strikes after the November 3 midterms are possible') is the dominant NO-weight — it explicitly frames the US midterm election as a pacing constraint on major offensive action. Counterweights: third carrier strike group + second Marine expeditionary unit deployed October 1 (largest US naval concentration of the current conflict cycle); US Ambassador alleges 60% uranium enrichment October 2 (IAEA-unverified); IRGC captured US unmanned underwater vehicle. Force posture and 60% allegation preserve a rapid-strike option; presidential restraint framing through November 3 is the primary determinant. An Iranian provocation above the current tactical threshold (direct strike on US warship, confirmed 90%+ enrichment) could override the pre-midterm restraint calculus.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or DoD publicly confirms a strike package against targets inside Iranian sovereign territory (Khuzestan, Fars, Tehran perimeter, or other mainland sites) involving ≥10 aircraft sorties OR ≥5 cruise/ballistic missile launches, executed before EOD November 3, 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM press release or DoD public statement, corroborated by Reuters/AP/AFP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Strikes on Iranian-affiliated forces outside Iranian territory (Syria, Iraq, Yemen) do NOT count. Strikes on IRGC naval assets in the Strait count only if the assets are in Iranian territorial waters and the strike package meets the size threshold. Below-threshold interdiction operations = NO.

indicators.name: Iranian kinetic attack on US Navy warship (direct)
IAEA or CENTCOM confirms Iranian uranium enrichment above 85% (US Ambassador alleges 60%, IAEA-unverified)

forecasts.question: Will Iran and the US sign or publicly announce a written ceasefire or framework agreement before EOD 2026-11-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 58-day forecast. Complete diplomatic freeze as of October 3. The UNGA round (September 23–29) ended with: Trump rejecting Iran's seven-step road map (September 26); Rubio expelling the Iranian delegation from New York (September 29); a senior US official stating nuclear preconditions are non-negotiable (September 28). Core sequencing dispute unresolved: Iran demands sanctions/blockade relief first; US demands nuclear concession first. Post-Islamabad MOU collapse (August 17) is the structural baseline. FM Araghchi stated 'no flexibility' on nuclear sequencing. Post-midterm (after November 3), Trump's own statement leaves open the possibility of resumed strikes, not a deal. P=0.07 assigned as a residual probability for a scenario where US midterm results and/or a catastrophic economic shock (Brent crude above $180 sustained) force a rapid diplomatic circuit-breaker.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM + State Department + a named Iranian official jointly confirm a written, signed document committing both parties to a halt in offensive operations and a defined diplomatic process, before EOD November 30, 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Joint statement OR dual-confirmation (US + Iranian state media) of the same signed document, carried by at least two TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral ceasefire declaration by either side without the other's confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A verbal understanding without written text = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
